passages.text: Solomon, however, took thirteen years to complete the construction of his entire palace.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Solomon built his own palace.
He spent thirteen years building it.
He finished the entire palace.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בֵּיתוֹ֙ בָּנָ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַיְכַ֖ל אֶת־ כָּל־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He built the House of the Forest of Lebanon a hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high, with four rows of cedar pillars supporting the cedar beams.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He built the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
The house was one hundred cubits long.
It was fifty cubits wide.
It was thirty cubits high.
The house stood on four rows of cedar pillars.
Cedar beams rested on the pillars.
passages.original: וַיִּ֜בֶן אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית׀ יַ֣עַר הַלְּבָנ֗וֹן מֵאָ֨ה אַמָּ֤ה אָרְכּוֹ֙ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָת֑וֹ עַ֗ל אַרְבָּעָה֙ טוּרֵי֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י אֲרָזִ֔ים וּכְרֻת֥וֹת אֲרָזִ֖ים עַל־ הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃

passages.text: The house was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the pillars—forty-five beams, fifteen per row.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
He used cedar wood for the roof.
The cedar roof lay above the beams.
The beams rested on pillars.
There were forty-five beams in total.
Each row had fifteen beams.
The beams supported the cedar roof.
passages.original: וְסָפֻ֣ן בָּאֶ֗רֶז מִמַּ֙עַל֙ עַל־ הַצְּלָעֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הָֽעַמּוּדִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֖ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר הַטּֽוּר׃

passages.text: There were three rows of high windows facing one another in three tiers.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
He made three rows of high windows.
The windows faced each other.
He arranged the windows in three tiers.
passages.original: וּשְׁקֻפִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה טוּרִ֑ים וּמֶחֱזָ֥ה אֶל־ מֶחֱזָ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים׃

passages.text: All the doorways had rectangular frames, with the openings facing one another in three tiers.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built a great house.
He made all the doorways with rectangular frames.
Each doorway had a frame shaped like a rectangle.
The openings faced each other.
There were three rows of these openings.
Each row matched the others.
passages.original: וְכָל־ הַפְּתָחִ֥ים וְהַמְּזוּז֖וֹת רְבֻעִ֣ים שָׁ֑קֶף וּמ֧וּל מֶחֱזָ֛ה אֶל־ מֶחֱזָ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים׃

passages.text: Solomon made his colonnade fifty cubits long and thirty cubits wide, with a portico in front of it and a canopy with pillars in front of the portico.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built a colonnade.
The colonnade was fifty cubits long.
The colonnade was thirty cubits wide.
A portico stood in front of the colonnade.
A canopy with pillars stood in front of the portico.
passages.original: וְאֵ֨ת אוּלָ֤ם הָֽעַמּוּדִים֙ עָשָׂ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבּ֑וֹ וְאוּלָם֙ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וְעַמֻּדִ֥ים וְעָ֖ב עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: In addition, he built a hall for the throne, the Hall of Justice, where he was to judge. It was paneled with cedar from floor to ceiling.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He built a special hall.
This hall was for his throne.
People called it the Hall of Justice.
Solomon judged people there.
He covered the hall with cedar wood.
The cedar wood went from the floor to the ceiling.
passages.original: וְאוּלָ֤ם הַכִּסֵּא֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁפָּט־ שָׁ֔ם אֻלָ֥ם הַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט עָשָׂ֑ה וְסָפ֣וּן בָּאֶ֔רֶז מֵהַקַּרְקַ֖ע עַד־ הַקַּרְקָֽע׃

passages.text: And the palace where Solomon would live, set further back, was of similar construction. He also made a palace like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had married.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Solomon built a palace for himself.
This palace was set further back from the hall.
The palace was built in the same way as the hall.
Solomon also built a palace for Pharaoh’s daughter.
Pharaoh’s daughter was Solomon’s wife.
Her palace was built like the hall.
passages.original: וּבֵיתוֹ֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יֵ֨שֶׁב שָׁ֜ם חָצֵ֣ר הָאַחֶ֗רֶת מִבֵּית֙ לָֽאוּלָ֔ם כַּמַּֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה הָיָ֑ה וּבַ֜יִת יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לְבַת־ פַּרְעֹה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקַ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה כָּאוּלָ֖ם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: All these buildings were constructed with costly stones, cut to size and trimmed with saws inside and out from the foundation to the eaves, and from the outside to the great courtyard.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built many buildings.
He used costly stones for all these buildings.
Workers cut the stones to the right size.
They trimmed the stones with saws.
They worked on the stones both inside and outside the buildings.
They placed the stones from the foundation up to the eaves.
They also placed stones from the outside up to the great courtyard.
passages.original: כָּל־ אֵ֜לֶּה אֲבָנִ֤ים יְקָרֹת֙ כְּמִדֹּ֣ת גָּזִ֔ית מְגֹרָר֥וֹת בַּמְּגֵרָ֖ה מִבַּ֣יִת וּמִח֑וּץ וּמִמַּסָּד֙ עַד־ הַטְּפָח֔וֹת וּמִח֖וּץ עַד־ הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַגְּדוֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: The foundations were laid with large, costly stones, some ten cubits long and some eight cubits long.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the foundations of these buildings.
He used large stones for the foundations.
These stones were costly.
Some stones were ten cubits long.
Some stones were eight cubits long.
passages.original: וּמְיֻסָּ֕ד אֲבָנִ֥ים יְקָר֖וֹת אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֑וֹת אַבְנֵי֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֔וֹת וְאַבְנֵ֖י שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה אַמּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Above these were high-grade stones, cut to size, and cedar beams.
passages.sermon: The builders placed high-grade stones above the foundation.\r\nThey cut these stones to the right size.\r\nThey also placed cedar beams above the foundation.
passages.original: וּמִלְמַ֗עְלָה אֲבָנִ֧ים יְקָר֛וֹת כְּמִדּ֥וֹת גָּזִ֖ית וָאָֽרֶז׃

passages.text: The great courtyard was surrounded by three rows of dressed stone and a row of trimmed cedar beams, as were the inner courtyard and portico of the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The great courtyard stood outside the temple.
Three rows of dressed stone surrounded the courtyard.
One row of trimmed cedar beams also surrounded it.
The inner courtyard of the house of the LORD had the same design.
The portico of the house of the LORD also had this design.
passages.original: וְחָצֵ֨ר הַגְּדוֹלָ֜ה סָבִ֗יב שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ טוּרִ֣ים גָּזִ֔ית וְט֖וּר כְּרֻתֹ֣ת אֲרָזִ֑ים וְלַחֲצַ֧ר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֛ה הַפְּנִימִ֖ית וּלְאֻלָ֥ם הַבָּֽיִת׃פ

passages.text: Now King Solomon sent to bring Huram from Tyre.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon was the king of Israel.
King Solomon sent messengers.
King Solomon sent these messengers to Tyre.
King Solomon brought Huram from Tyre.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַיִּקַּ֥ח אֶת־ חִירָ֖ם מִצֹּֽר׃

passages.text: He was the son of a widow from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a craftsman in bronze. Huram had great skill, understanding, and knowledge for every kind of bronze work. So he came to King Solomon and carried out all his work.
passages.sermon:
Huram was the son of a widow from the tribe of Naphtali.
His father was a man from Tyre.
His father worked as a craftsman in bronze.
Huram was filled with wisdom.
He had understanding.
He had knowledge.
He could do every kind of work in bronze.
Huram came to King Solomon.
He did all the work that King Solomon gave him.
passages.original: בֶּן־ אִשָּׁה֩ אַלְמָנָ֨ה ה֜וּא מִמַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י וְאָבִ֣יו אִישׁ־ צֹרִי֮ חֹרֵ֣שׁ נְחֹשֶׁת֒ וַ֠יִּמָּלֵא אֶת־ הַחָכְמָ֤ה וְאֶת־ הַתְּבוּנָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַדַּ֔עַת לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה בַּנְּחֹ֑שֶׁת וַיָּבוֹא֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־ כָּל־ מְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He cast two pillars of bronze, each eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference.
passages.sermon:
Huram was a skilled craftsman in bronze.
King Solomon brought Huram from Tyre.
Huram made two pillars of bronze.
Each pillar was eighteen cubits high.
Each pillar was twelve cubits in circumference.
passages.original: וַיָּ֛צַר אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה אַמָּ֗ה קוֹמַת֙ הָעַמּ֣וּד הָאֶחָ֔ד וְחוּט֙ שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֖ב אֶת־ הָעַמּ֥וּד הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃

passages.text: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on top of the pillars, each capital five cubits high.
passages.sermon:
Huram was a skilled craftsman in bronze.
He made two capitals.
He used cast bronze for the capitals.
He placed the capitals on top of the pillars.
Each capital was five cubits high.
passages.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֨י כֹתָרֹ֜ת עָשָׂ֗ה לָתֵ֛ת עַל־ רָאשֵׁ֥י הָֽעַמּוּדִ֖ים מֻצַ֣ק נְחֹ֑שֶׁת חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֗וֹת קוֹמַת֙ הַכֹּתֶ֣רֶת הָאֶחָ֔ת וְחָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת קוֹמַ֖ת הַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

passages.text: For the capitals on top of the pillars he made a network of lattice, with wreaths of chainwork, seven for each capital.
passages.sermon:
A man made two pillars.
He placed a capital on top of each pillar.
He made a network of lattice for the capitals.
He also made wreaths of chainwork for the capitals.
He put seven wreaths on one capital.
He put seven wreaths on the other capital.
passages.original: שְׂבָכִ֞ים מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂבָכָ֗ה גְּדִלִים֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שַׁרְשְׁר֔וֹת לַכֹּ֣תָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֑ים שִׁבְעָה֙ לַכֹּתֶ֣רֶת הָאֶחָ֔ת וְשִׁבְעָ֖ה לַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

passages.text: Likewise, he made the pillars with two rows of pomegranates around each grating to cover each capital atop the pillars.
passages.sermon:
A craftsman made two pillars.
He placed a capital on top of each pillar.
He made a grating for each capital.
He made two rows of pomegranates around each grating.
These pomegranates covered the capitals on top of the pillars.
He did the same for both capitals.
passages.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־ הָעַמּוּדִ֑ים וּשְׁנֵי֩ טוּרִ֨ים סָבִ֜יב עַל־ הַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֗ת לְכַסּ֤וֹת אֶת־ הַכֹּֽתָרֹת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָֽרִמֹּנִ֔ים וְכֵ֣ן עָשָׂ֔ה לַכֹּתֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

passages.text: And the capitals atop the pillars in the portico were shaped like lilies, four cubits high.
passages.sermon:
The pillars stood in the portico of the temple.
Each pillar had a capital on top.
The capitals were shaped like lilies.
Each capital was four cubits high.
passages.original: וְכֹֽתָרֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה שׁוּשַׁ֣ן בָּֽאוּלָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֖ע אַמּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: On the capitals of both pillars, just above the rounded projection next to the network, were the two hundred pomegranates in rows encircling each capital.
passages.sermon:
The craftsmen made two pillars for the temple entrance.
Each pillar had a capital on top.
Each capital had a rounded projection below it.
Next to this projection was a decorative network.
They placed two hundred pomegranates on each capital.
The pomegranates formed rows.
The rows of pomegranates encircled each capital.
passages.original: וְכֹתָרֹ֗ת עַל־ שְׁנֵי֙ הָֽעַמּוּדִ֔ים גַּם־ מִמַּ֙עַל֙ מִלְּעֻמַּ֣ת הַבֶּ֔טֶן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְעֵ֣בֶר שְׂבָכָה וְהָרִמּוֹנִ֤ים מָאתַ֙יִם֙ טֻרִ֣ים סָבִ֔יב עַ֖ל הַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

passages.text: Thus he set up the pillars at the portico of the temple. The pillar to the south he named Jachin, and the pillar to the north he named Boaz.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem.
He set up two large pillars at the entrance of the temple portico.
He placed one pillar on the south side.
He named the south pillar Jachin.
He placed the other pillar on the north side.
He named the north pillar Boaz.
passages.original: וַיָּ֙קֶם֙ אֶת־ הָֽעַמֻּדִ֔ים לְאֻלָ֖ם הַֽהֵיכָ֑ל וַיָּ֜קֶם אֶת־ הָעַמּ֣וּד הַיְמָנִ֗י וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־ שְׁמוֹ֙ יָכִ֔ין וַיָּ֙קֶם֙ אֶת־ הָעַמּ֣וּד הַשְּׂמָאלִ֔י וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ בֹּֽעַז׃

passages.text: And the tops of the pillars were shaped like lilies. So the work of the pillars was completed.
passages.sermon: The tops of the pillars had a lily shape.\r\nThe workers finished making the pillars.
passages.original: וְעַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שׁוֹשָׁ֑ן וַתִּתֹּ֖ם מְלֶ֥אכֶת הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃

passages.text: He also made the Sea of cast metal. It was circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim, five cubits in height, and thirty cubits in circumference.
passages.sermon:
A man made a large basin called the Sea.
He used cast metal to make it.
The Sea was round.
It measured ten cubits from one rim to the other rim.
It stood five cubits high.
The Sea had a circumference of thirty cubits.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּ֠אַמָּה מִשְּׂפָת֨וֹ עַד־ שְׂפָת֜וֹ עָגֹ֣ל׀ סָבִ֗יב וְחָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ קוֹמָת֔וֹ וּקְוֵה שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Below the rim, ornamental buds encircled it, ten per cubit all the way around the Sea, cast in two rows as a part of the Sea.
passages.sermon:
The Sea was a large basin made of cast metal.
Ornamental buds decorated the Sea.
These buds were below the rim.
The buds went all the way around the Sea.
There were ten buds for every cubit.
The buds formed two rows.
The buds were cast as part of the Sea.
passages.original: וּפְקָעִים֩ מִתַּ֨חַת לִשְׂפָת֤וֹ׀ סָבִיב֙ סֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה מַקִּפִ֥ים אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנֵ֤י טוּרִים֙ הַפְּקָעִ֔ים יְצֻקִ֖ים בִּיצֻקָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The Sea stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The Sea rested on them, with all their hindquarters toward the center.
passages.sermon:
The Sea was a large basin made for the temple.
The Sea stood on twelve oxen.
Three oxen faced north.
Three oxen faced west.
Three oxen faced south.
Three oxen faced east.
The Sea rested on top of the oxen.
All the hindquarters of the oxen pointed inward, toward the center.
passages.original: עֹמֵ֞ד עַל־ שְׁנֵ֧י עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים׀ צָפ֡וֹנָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים׀ יָ֜מָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה׀ פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָה וְהַיָּ֥ם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְכָל־ אֲחֹֽרֵיהֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָה׃

passages.text: It was a handbreadth thick, and its rim was fashioned like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It could hold two thousand baths.
passages.sermon:
The Sea was a large basin in Solomon’s Temple.
The Sea was made of bronze.
The Sea was very thick.
Its thickness was a handbreadth.
The rim of the Sea was shaped like the rim of a cup.
The rim looked like a lily flower.
The Sea could hold two thousand baths of water.
passages.original: וְעָבְי֣וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּשְׂפָת֛וֹ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה שְׂפַת־ כּ֖וֹס פֶּ֣רַח שׁוֹשָׁ֑ן אַלְפַּ֥יִם בַּ֖ת יָכִֽיל׃פ

passages.text: In addition, he made ten movable stands of bronze, each four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.
passages.sermon:
He made ten stands.
He made these stands from bronze.
Each stand could move.
Each stand was four cubits long.
Each stand was four cubits wide.
Each stand was three cubits high.
passages.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת־ הַמְּכֹנ֛וֹת עֶ֖שֶׂר נְחֹ֑שֶׁת אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֗ה אֹ֚רֶךְ הַמְּכוֹנָ֣ה הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וְאַרְבַּ֤ע בָּֽאַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔הּ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ בָּאַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: This was the design of the stands: They had side panels attached to uprights, and on the panels between the uprights were lions, oxen, and cherubim. On the uprights was a pedestal above, and below the lions and oxen were wreaths of beveled work.
passages.sermon:
The stands had a special design.
Each stand had side panels.
The panels were attached to uprights.
Between the uprights, the panels showed lions.
The panels also showed oxen.
The panels also showed cherubim.
There was a pedestal above the uprights.
Below the lions and oxen, there were wreaths.
The wreaths were made with beveled work.
passages.original: וְזֶ֛ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַמְּכוֹנָ֖ה מִסְגְּרֹ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וּמִסְגְּרֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין הַשְׁלַבִּֽים׃ וְעַֽל־ הַמִּסְגְּר֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ בֵּ֣ין הַשְׁלַבִּ֗ים אֲרָי֤וֹת׀ בָּקָר֙ וּכְרוּבִ֔ים וְעַל־ הַשְׁלַבִּ֖ים כֵּ֣ן מִמָּ֑עַל וּמִתַּ֙חַת֙ לַאֲרָי֣וֹת וְלַבָּקָ֔ר לֹי֖וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה מוֹרָֽד׃

passages.text: Each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles and a basin resting on four supports, with wreaths at each side.
passages.sermon:
Each stand had four wheels.
The wheels were made of bronze.
Each stand had bronze axles.
A basin rested on four supports.
The supports were under the basin.
Each support had a wreath at its side.
The wreaths were decorative.
The supports were cast as part of the stand.
passages.original: וְאַרְבָּעָה֩ אוֹפַנֵּ֨י נְחֹ֜שֶׁת לַמְּכוֹנָ֤ה הָֽאַחַת֙ וְסַרְנֵ֣י נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה פַעֲמֹתָ֖יו כְּתֵפֹ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם מִתַּ֤חַת לַכִּיֹּר֙ הַכְּתֵפֹ֣ת יְצֻק֔וֹת מֵעֵ֥בֶר אִ֖ישׁ לֹיֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The opening to each stand inside the crown at the top was one cubit deep, with a round opening like the design of a pedestal, a cubit and a half wide. And around its opening were engravings, but the panels of the stands were square, not round.
passages.sermon:
Each stand had an opening at the top.
This opening was inside the crown of the stand.
The opening was one cubit deep.
The opening was round.
The round opening was made like a pedestal.
The opening was one and a half cubits wide.
There were engravings around the opening.
The panels of the stands were square.
The panels were not round.
passages.original: וּ֠פִיהוּ מִבֵּ֨ית לַכֹּתֶ֤רֶת וָמַ֙עְלָה֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וּפִ֙יהָ֙ עָגֹ֣ל מַעֲשֵׂה־ כֵ֔ן אַמָּ֖ה וַחֲצִ֣י הָֽאַמָּ֑ה וְגַם־ עַל־ פִּ֙יהָ֙ מִקְלָע֔וֹת וּמִסְגְּרֹתֵיהֶ֥ם מְרֻבָּע֖וֹת לֹ֥א עֲגֻלּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: There were four wheels under the panels, and the axles of the wheels were attached to the stand; each wheel was a cubit and a half in diameter.
passages.sermon:
Each stand had four wheels.
The wheels were under the panels.
The axles of the wheels were attached to the stand.
Each wheel was a cubit and a half in diameter.
passages.original: וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת הָאֽוֹפַנִּ֗ים לְמִתַּ֙חַת֙ לַֽמִּסְגְּר֔וֹת וִיד֥וֹת הָאֽוֹפַנִּ֖ים בַּמְּכוֹנָ֑ה וְקוֹמַת֙ הָאוֹפַ֣ן הָאֶחָ֔ד אַמָּ֖ה וַחֲצִ֥י הָאַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: The wheels were made like chariot wheels; their axles, rims, spokes, and hubs were all of cast metal.
passages.sermon:
The wheels were made for the stands in the temple.
The wheels looked like chariot wheels.
The axles of the wheels were made of cast metal.
The rims of the wheels were made of cast metal.
The spokes of the wheels were made of cast metal.
The hubs of the wheels were made of cast metal.
All parts of the wheels were cast metal.
passages.original: וּמַֽעֲשֵׂה֙ הָא֣וֹפַנִּ֔ים כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אוֹפַ֣ן הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֑ה יְדוֹתָ֣ם וְגַבֵּיהֶ֗ם וְחִשֻּׁקֵיהֶ֛ם וְחִשֻּׁרֵיהֶ֖ם הַכֹּ֥ל מוּצָֽק׃

passages.text: Each stand had four handles, one for each corner, projecting from the stand.
passages.sermon: Each stand had four handles.\r\nOne handle was at each corner of the stand.\r\nThe handles projected from the stand itself.
passages.original: וְאַרְבַּ֣ע כְּתֵפ֔וֹת אֶ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנּ֔וֹת הַמְּכֹנָ֖ה הָֽאֶחָ֑ת מִן־ הַמְּכֹנָ֖ה כְּתֵפֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: At the top of each stand was a circular band half a cubit high. The supports and panels were cast as a unit with the top of the stand.
passages.sermon:
Each stand had a top part.
This top part had a circular band.
The band was half a cubit high.
The top of the stand included its supports.
The top of the stand included its panels.
The supports and panels were cast together with the top.
passages.original: וּבְרֹ֣אשׁ הַמְּכוֹנָ֗ה חֲצִ֧י הָאַמָּ֛ה קוֹמָ֖ה עָגֹ֣ל׀ סָבִ֑יב וְעַ֨ל רֹ֤אשׁ הַמְּכֹנָה֙ יְדֹתֶ֔יהָ וּמִסְגְּרֹתֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

passages.text: He engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and panels, wherever each had space, with wreaths all around.
passages.sermon:
He engraved decorations on the stands.
He engraved cherubim on the supports and panels.
He engraved lions on the supports and panels.
He engraved palm trees on the supports and panels.
He placed these engravings wherever there was space.
He added wreaths all around the decorations.
passages.original: וַיְפַתַּ֤ח עַל־ הַלֻּחֹת֙ יְדֹתֶ֔יהָ וְעַל֙ וּמִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ כְּרוּבִ֖ים אֲרָי֣וֹת וְתִמֹרֹ֑ת כְּמַֽעַר־ אִ֥ישׁ וְלֹי֖וֹת סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: In this way he made the ten stands, each with the same casting, dimensions, and shape.
passages.sermon:
Huram was a skilled craftsman.
Huram made ten stands for the temple.
He used the same casting for each stand.
He made all ten stands with the same dimensions.
He made all ten stands with the same shape.
passages.original: כָּזֹ֣את עָשָׂ֔ה אֵ֖ת עֶ֣שֶׂר הַמְּכֹנ֑וֹת מוּצָ֨ק אֶחָ֜ד מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת קֶ֥צֶב אֶחָ֖ד לְכֻלָּֽהְנָה׃ס

passages.text: He also made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin for each of the ten stands.
passages.sermon:
Huram made ten basins.
He made each basin from bronze.
Each basin could hold forty baths of water.
Each basin measured four cubits across.
He placed one basin on each of the ten stands.
passages.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ עֲשָׂרָ֥ה כִיֹּר֖וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת אַרְבָּעִ֨ים בַּ֜ת יָכִ֣יל׀ הַכִּיּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֗ד אַרְבַּ֤ע בָּֽאַמָּה֙ הַכִּיּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֔ד כִּיּ֤וֹר אֶחָד֙ עַל־ הַמְּכוֹנָ֣ה הָאַחַ֔ת לְעֶ֖שֶׂר הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: He set five stands on the south side of the temple and five on the north, and he put the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner of the temple.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
He built the temple of the LORD.
He placed ten stands in the temple.
He set five stands on the right side of the temple.
He set five stands on the left side of the temple.
He put the Sea on the right side of the temple.
He placed the Sea at the southeast corner of the temple.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־ הַמְּכֹנ֔וֹת חָמֵ֞שׁ עַל־ כֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֙יִת֙ מִיָּמִ֔ין וְחָמֵ֛שׁ עַל־ כֶּ֥תֶף הַבַּ֖יִת מִשְּׂמֹאל֑וֹ וְאֶת־ הַיָּ֗ם נָתַ֞ן מִכֶּ֨תֶף הַבַּ֧יִת הַיְמָנִ֛ית קֵ֖דְמָה מִמּ֥וּל נֶֽגֶב׃ס

passages.text: Additionally, Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished all the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of the LORD: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars; the two sets of network covering both bowls of the capitals atop the pillars; the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars); the ten stands; the ten basins on the stands; the Sea; the twelve oxen underneath the Sea; and the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. All the articles that Huram made for King Solomon in the house of the LORD were made of burnished bronze.
passages.sermon:
Huram was a skilled craftsman.
Huram made the pots.
Huram made the shovels.
Huram made the sprinkling bowls.
Huram finished all the work for King Solomon.
Huram worked for the house of the LORD.
Huram made two pillars.
Huram made two bowl-shaped capitals for the tops of the pillars.
Huram made two sets of network to cover the two capitals on the pillars.
Huram made four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network.
Each set of network had two rows of pomegranates.
The networks covered both bowl-shaped capitals on the pillars.
Huram made ten stands.
Huram made ten basins for the stands.
Huram made the Sea.
Huram made twelve oxen to go under the Sea.
Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls.
Huram made all these articles for King Solomon in the house of the LORD.
Huram used burnished bronze for all these items.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ חִיר֔וֹם אֶת־ הַ֨כִּיֹּר֔וֹת וְאֶת־ הַיָּעִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְרָק֑וֹת וַיְכַ֣ל חִירָ֗ם לַֽעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ עַמֻּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם וְגֻלֹּ֧ת הַכֹּתָרֹ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָֽעַמֻּדִ֖ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם וְהַשְּׂבָכ֣וֹת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלֹּ֣ת הַכֹּֽתָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃ וְאֶת־ הָרִמֹּנִ֛ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת לִשְׁתֵּ֣י הַשְּׂבָכ֑וֹת שְׁנֵֽי־ טוּרִ֤ים רִמֹּנִים֙ לַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָֽאֶחָ֔ת לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלֹּ֣ת הַכֹּֽתָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃ וְאֶת־ הַמְּכֹנ֖וֹת עָ֑שֶׂר וְאֶת־ הַכִּיֹּרֹ֥ת עֲשָׂרָ֖ה עַל־ הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת׃ וְאֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם הָאֶחָ֑ד וְאֶת־ הַבָּקָ֥ר שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֖ר תַּ֥חַת הַיָּֽם׃ וְאֶת־ הַסִּיר֨וֹת וְאֶת־ הַיָּעִ֜ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְרָק֗וֹת וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֣ים הָאֹהֶל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה חִירָ֛ם לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מְמֹרָֽט׃

passages.text: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon made many bronze items for the temple of the LORD.
He used clay molds to make these items.
He cast them in the plain of the Jordan.
This place was between Succoth and Zarethan.
passages.original: בְּכִכַּ֤ר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בְּמַעֲבֵ֖ה הָאֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּבֵ֥ין צָרְתָֽן׃

passages.text: Solomon left all these articles unweighed, because there were so many. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
Solomon made many articles for the house of the LORD.
He left all these articles unweighed.
There were so many articles.
No one could determine the weight of the bronze.
passages.original: וַיַּנַּ֤ח שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים מֵרֹ֖ב מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: Solomon also made all the furnishings for the house of the LORD: the golden altar; the golden table on which was placed the Bread of the Presence; the lampstands of pure gold in front of the inner sanctuary, five on the right side and five on the left; the gold flowers, lamps, and tongs; the pure gold basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers; and the gold hinges for the doors of the inner temple (that is, the Most Holy Place ) as well as for the doors of the main hall of the temple.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon made all the furnishings for the house of the LORD.
He made the golden altar.
He made the golden table.
The Bread of the Presence was placed on this table.
He made ten lampstands of pure gold.
He put five lampstands on the right side in front of the inner sanctuary.
He put five lampstands on the left side in front of the inner sanctuary.
He made gold flowers.
He made gold lamps.
He made gold tongs.
He made pure gold basins.
He made pure gold wick trimmers.
He made pure gold sprinkling bowls.
He made pure gold ladles.
He made pure gold censers.
He made gold hinges for the doors of the inner temple.
The inner temple is the Most Holy Place.
He also made gold hinges for the doors of the main hall of the temple.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֚ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלָ֛יו לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִ֖ים זָהָֽב׃ וְאֶת־ הַ֠מְּנֹרוֹת חָמֵ֨שׁ מִיָּמִ֜ין וְחָמֵ֧שׁ מִשְּׂמֹ֛אול לִפְנֵ֥י הַדְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וְהַפֶּ֧רַח וְהַנֵּרֹ֛ת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַ֖יִם זָהָֽב׃ וְ֠הַסִּפּוֹת וְהַֽמְזַמְּר֧וֹת וְהַמִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְהַכַּפּ֥וֹת וְהַמַּחְתּ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וְהַפֹּת֡וֹת לְדַלְתוֹת֩ הַבַּ֨יִת הַפְּנִימִ֜י לְקֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים לְדַלְתֵ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת לַהֵיכָ֖ל זָהָֽב׃פ

passages.text: So all the work that King Solomon had performed for the house of the LORD was completed. Then Solomon brought in the items his father David had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon finished all the work for the house of the LORD.
He completed everything he had planned for the temple.
Solomon brought in the items his father David had dedicated.
These items included silver.
They also included gold.
They included various furnishings.
Solomon placed all these items in the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וַתִּשְׁלַם֙ כָּל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּבֵ֨א שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת־ קָדְשֵׁ֣י׀ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֗יו אֶת־ הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָב֙ וְאֶת־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים נָתַ֕ן בְּאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃פ
